subject: Geography A
title: GCSE (9-1) Geography A
sourceNote: Pearson Edexcel Level 1/Level 2 GCSE (9-1) Geography A specification, Issue 5, September 2025: the copy of Pearson's published PDF captured by the Internet Archive on 2026-08-03 (qualifications.pearson.com could not be reached directly from the build environment).
notes: Numbering: Pearson numbers each key idea within its topic (1.1, 1.2 ... 8.4) and letters the detailed content beneath it (1.1a, 1.1b). Key ideas are the leaf points (refs); the lettered detail and the numbered integrated skills are not separate refs.

One topic = one pack. Optional sub-topics are topics of their own, marked '(option)': two of 1A Coastal, 1B River and 1C Glaciated upland landscapes; one of 6A Energy and 6B Water resource management. Their topic refs are Pearson's sub-topic labels (1A, 1B, 1C, 6A, 6B).

The compulsory overview of Topic 1 (1.1–1.2, Overview of the UK’s physical landscape) is short, so it is a subtopic (1.g0) shared by 1A, 1B and 1C rather than a pack of its own. The Topic 6 overview (6.1–6.2) is its own pack, Topic 6.

Subtopics have registry refs (<topic>.g<n>): Pearson's printed headings where there are any (Tropical cyclones, Drought, case studies), otherwise short groupings of key ideas titled for the registry. parents maps each key idea to its subtopic.
Topic 8 (UK challenges) is kept: it is examined content drawing on Components 1 and 2 (its 'Related topics' column is copied into the text file), not fieldwork or pre-release.
Skipped: Topic 7 Geographical investigations − fieldwork (school-dependent), and the separate Geographical skills section (skills are listed with each key idea in the text files but are not refs).
